## Why visit

Cloudwater’s central pub offers a useful alternative setting for exploring the brewery’s beers, particularly when your day is centred on Victoria and the northern historic pubs. The low wooden building and communal interior make an interesting modern contribution to Manchester’s pub landscape. Come for a considered cask or two and the unusual room, or use it as a convenient meeting point before a longer pub walk. Its purpose in this wiki is a compact city-pub experience; visitors already spending an afternoon at Cloudwater’s production taproom can make it optional.

## Beer

CAMRA lists three changing cask beers alongside a larger keg selection. Cloudwater’s official page describes beers from the brewery and guests; consult the current board.

## Food

The current official page explicitly says crisps and snacks only. Do not rely on CAMRA’s meal icons for a substantial meal.

## Plan the visit

Formerly the Pilcrow. This is the NOMA pub, separate from Cloudwater Unit 9. Official information lists a later Monday opening; check the current hours. Postcodes differ between sources, so use the named yard and street.

**Getting there:** Near Manchester Victoria; useful alongside the northern city-centre and Angel Meadow clusters.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
